00054 void ScalarUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int /*blockID*/, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00055 {       
00056     const int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00057     float* const outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();    
00058     vDSP_vfill(&value_, outputSamples, 1, numSamplesToProcess);
00059 }

00101 void MixUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00102 {
00103     int channel = 0;
00104     
00105     bool shouldDeleteLocal = false;
00106     bool& shouldDeleteToPass = shouldAllowAutoDelete_ ? shouldDelete : shouldDeleteLocal;   
00107     const int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00108     float* const outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00109     const float* const channelSamples = inputs->processBlock(shouldDeleteToPass, blockID, channel);
00110         
00111 //#ifdef UGEN_IPHONE
00112 //  cblas_ccopy(numSamplesToProcess, channelSamples, 1, outputSamples, 1);
00113 //#else
00114 //  vScopy(numSamplesToProcess, (const vFloat*)channelSamples, (vFloat*)outputSamples); // might not be x4
00115 //#endif    
00116     
00117     memcpy(outputSamples, channelSamples, numSamplesToProcess*sizeof(float));
00118     
00119     channel++;
00120     
00121     int numChannels = inputs->getNumChannels();
00122     
00123     for(/* leave channel value alone */; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00124     {
00125         shouldDeleteLocal = false;
00126         float* const channelSamples = inputs->processBlock(shouldDeleteToPass, blockID, channel);
00127         
00128         // must check vDSP_vadd() can operate in place
00129         vDSP_vadd(outputSamples, 1, channelSamples, 1, outputSamples, 1, numSamplesToProcess);
00130     }   
00131 }

00134 void MixArrayUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00135 {   
00136     bool shouldDeleteLocal;
00137     bool& shouldDeleteToPass = shouldAllowAutoDelete_ ? shouldDelete : shouldDeleteLocal;   
00138     int numOutputChannels = getNumChannels();
00139     const int arraySize = arrayRef.size();
00140     const int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00141     
00142     for(int channel = 0; channel < numOutputChannels; channel++)
00143     {
00144         float* const outputSamples = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();     
00145         vDSP_vclr(outputSamples, 1, numSamplesToProcess);
00146         
00147         for(int arrayIndex = 0; arrayIndex < arraySize; arrayIndex++)
00148         {
00149             shouldDeleteLocal = false;
00150             float* const channelSamples = arrayRef[arrayIndex].processBlock(shouldDeleteToPass, blockID, channel);
00151             
00152             // must check vDSP_vadd() can operate in place
00153             vDSP_vadd(outputSamples, 1, channelSamples, 1, outputSamples, 1, numSamplesToProcess);
00154         }
00155     }
00156 }

00159 void MulAddUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00160 {
00161     const int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00162     float* const outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00163     float* const inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00164     float* const mulSamples = inputs[Mul].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00165     float* const addSamples = inputs[Add].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel); 
00166     vDSP_vma(inputSamples, 1, mulSamples, 1, addSamples, 1, outputSamples, 1, numSamplesToProcess);
00167 }
